answer.value:
Gender discrimination refers to women being economically disadvantaged and deprived of opportunities. Reasons include:
Unequal gender ratio
Low female literacy rate
Low female workforce participation
Low female economic activity rate
Lower female participation in high-level government jobs compared to men
Low representation of women in state assemblies and Lok Sabha
